entries.to: Our Approach | Harbor Mind Therapy in Miami

entries.prefix: Compass Pathways is driven by an unwavering commitment
entries.to: How Harbor Mind works: licensed therapists, proven methods like CBT, EMDR and Gottman-informed couples work, and plans built around your goals.
Listen closely, use methods that work, and stay with you until life feels lighter. That’s the Harbor Mind approach.

entries.prefix: We're driven by our purpose to unlock pathways
entries.to: Our approach is simple: listen closely, use methods that work, and stay with you until life feels lighter.

entries.prefix: We are finders, inspired by seekers.
entries.to:
We are listeners, guided by your story.

Our work is dedicated to individuals, couples and families.

Your courage brings you here. Your resilience guides the work. Your goals shape every plan.

We open space for honest conversation.

Not a fresh start from nothing, but a steadier way forward.

Because every mind needs a harbor.
A calmer place  to land
Our Approach | Video Feature
More than a session
Three commitments shape every plan we build, so the support you get is personal, proven and safe.

entries.prefix: We believe it's important that the standards
entries.to: We believe the care you receive should match how much it took to reach out. That means seeing the same licensed therapist every week, setting goals you choose, and checking progress together instead of guessing. If something isn’t working, we change it.

entries.prefix: We are committed, above all else, to people seeking
entries.to: Above all, we’re committed to the people who walk through our door, or log on from home. Whether you come alone or with a partner, your goals set the direction and your comfort sets the pace.
SEE HOW WE HELP
Proven Methods

entries.prefix: Our commitment to scientific rigor guides everything
entries.to: We use approaches with strong research behind them, including CBT, DBT skills, EMDR, ACT and Gottman-informed couples therapy. Your therapist explains why a method fits you, and you can always ask to try something different.
EXPLORE WHAT WE TREAT
Your First Session
Download our short guide to what happens in a first session, what to bring, and how to tell if a therapist is the right fit.

entries.prefix: “Many of us have immediate family members
entries.to: “Most people who call us have been carrying something alone for far too long. Our job is simple: make the first step feel safe, and make sure no one has to take the next ones alone.”
Dr. Elena Marquez, Founder & Clinical Director
